scope: Eight standard public GitHub Windows VMs with the published EXE, generated microphone and native capture of the owned Windows test window; cloud WAN, not residential/5G or physical hardware audio

product.changes_for_this_test: test harness and documentation only; published product unchanged

method.microphones: Windows SAPI synthesized speech supplied as a generated microphone file; all 8 clients
method.screen: native owned WinForms window, actual getDisplayMedia window capture
method.rtt: Time-sampled most recent ICE RTT, not independent STUN probes and not end-to-end audio/video delay
method.guardrails: public personal repo; standard disposable VMs only; no larger runners, paid services, artifacts or caches; per-EXE scoped WebView overrides and loopback-only CDP

failed_receiver.interpretation: Reduced resolution already present in sender encoded RTP for this connection; did not recover before measurement ended. Independent clocks sampled about every 3 seconds; transitions are not exact synchronized timestamps. Root cause NOT_VERIFIED; qualityLimitationReason was not collected.

calibration.diagnostic: Runner display-mode change unavailable; optional picker helper did not find a picker because auto-selection had already completed. Real window HWND, dimensions, colored content and advancing frames were verified independently.

previous_baseline.notes: Voice passed; generated source advanced about 21 FPS rather than requested 30. Native VM identity and remote certificate instrumentation were incomplete. Corrected test window timer/STA/.NET Framework and evidence collection only; product and gates unchanged. Not used as the calibrated 30 FPS result.

not_verified: Residential ISP/5G routing and restrictive NAT
Physical microphones/speakers and human speech perception
Long-duration operation beyond the recorded phases
Physical Windows PCs, human listening scores, echo/acoustics and system-audio sharing
Root cause of P5 encoder resolution reduction
Geographic or ISP diversity; eight egress IPs are cloud endpoints within a single cloud provider
28 Mb/s screen saturation: the compressible native test scene averaged only 2.894 Mb/s video payload in total
